## Description {#details}

<p>Utility class representing a non-constant Xor-operand.</p>


<p>We classify non-constant Xor-Operands into two categories: C1) The operand is in the form "X &amp; C", where C is a constant and C != ~0 C2) C2.1) The operand is in the form of "X | C", where C is a non-zero constant. C2.2) <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/any">Any</a> operand E which doesn't fall into C1 and C2.1, we view this operand as "E | 0"</p>
